verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime has a dedicated cardholder-disputes doc stating disputes are handled 'in line with Regulation E (Reg E) and card network requirements' and separate ACH-returns tooling to reverse/return originated ACH transfers, giving ops some operational tooling. However, evidence never details Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit issuance/mechanics, or explicit ACH consumer-dispute (as opposed to origination return) handling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Reg E 10/45-day investigation timelines, provisional credit crediting/reversal mechanics, and ACH-specific consumer dispute (vs. ACH return) workflow and ops responsibilities.
